industry: AI-powered genomics and single-cell omics analytics
summary: Företag 22 develops analysis tools and SaaS services for genomics and single-cell omics data. The company provides an AI-native platform that helps researchers interpret complex biological datasets and accelerate discovery.
partnership_signal: research and life science ecosystem partnerships
target_market: Global life science, genomics and precision medicine market
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing AI-driven interpretation tools for single-cell and genomics workflows through a SaaS business model targeting research and drug discovery organizations.
technology_notes: Combines artificial intelligence, genomics analytics and cloud-based software to generate interpretable insights from complex biological datasets, particularly single-cell omics data.
risk_notes: Dependent on adoption within the life sciences sector, continued advances in AI and genomics, access to funding, and competition from established bioinformatics and analytics platforms.
